body:
# MOTD Plugin – The Ultimate MOTD Experience!

Give your server a modern, eye-catching MOTD!
Simple, fast & fully customizable.

Would you like to have a better server in the list of Minecraft servers that you have traveled to?

Then use the plugin X-MOTD-X

## 🎥 Tutorial Video

[Watch on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CB-ZNK9rXDg)

## ⚙️ Commands

```
/xmotdx reload
```

➡️ Reloads the configuration – no server restart required.

## 🔑 Permissions

```
xmotdx.reload
```

➡️ Allows reload only

## 🐞 Found a bug?

Please report any issues directly – thank you!
